name: Magaki Souji
source:
A dull and overweight man.

He is the younger brother of [url=https://vndb.org/c57320]Magaki Souichi[/url]. However, unlike his brother, he does not enjoy brainwashing others as an art form or job, he simply wants to satisfy his own desires.

[From [url=http://studiocharen.r.ribbon.to/sessyoku/index.html]official site[/url]]
